While the finding is accurate that the comment appears copy-pasted, this is purely a cosmetic comment-accuracy nit with no decision relevance: it does not describe incorrect behavior, the lazy wrapper is harmless, and removing or keeping the comment has no material consequence for review or shipping. This falls under style/preference noise.
